title: Tricyclazole 75 WP (Rice Blast Treatment)
description: Chemical fungicide used to control Rice Blast disease in paddy fields.

metadata.precautions: Avoid water logging in fields after application. Do not spray during rain.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Do not spray if rain probability is above 50% or winds exceed 15 km/h

title: Neem Oil Formulation 3000 ppm (Organic)
description: Organic bio-pesticide made from neem extract used to control fungal diseases and insects.

metadata.precautions: Ensure proper plant spacing before application. Best applied in early morning or evening.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Avoid spraying in strong winds or during active rainfall

title: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (Cotton Whitefly Control)
description: Systemic insecticide used to control whitefly vectors responsible for Cotton Leaf Curl disease.

metadata.targetPest: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) - vector of Cotton Leaf Curl Virus
metadata.precautions: Wear protective gear. Avoid spraying near water bodies. Keep away from children.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Do not spray during rain or strong winds

title: Mancozeb 75 WP (Tomato Early Blight Treatment)
description: Contact fungicide used to control Early Blight and other fungal diseases in tomato crops.

metadata.applicationMethod: Foliar spray - apply immediately at first sign of disease
metadata.precautions: Wear protective clothing. Wash hands after use.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Apply when no rain is expected for at least 6 hours

title: Trichoderma (Bio-Pesticide Fungal Control)
description: Biological fungicide made from beneficial Trichoderma fungi used for organic crop protection.

metadata.dosage: As per product label - typically 5-10 grams per liter of water
metadata.precautions: Store in cool place. Do not mix with chemical fungicides.
metadata.weatherConstraint: Best applied in humid conditions for spore germination; avoid strong UV sunlight
